description: Maharashtra approves Rs 11.26 crore for Sarvam AI solutions, including a sovereign AI workspace for 2,500 government users and citizen outreach tools
body_lead: Maharashtra approves Rs 11.26 crore sovereign AI package for state government departments The Maharashtra government has approved a two-year, Rs 11.26 crore package to deploy sovereign artificial intelligence solutions from Sarvam AI across state government departments Sarvam Official website (PICS/Sarvam Website) The Maharashtra government has granted approval for the deployment of sovereign artificial intelligence solutions from Sarvam AI for government departments with a two-year outlay of Rs 11.26 crore.
